about.title: About Me

My passion lies in designing end-to-end software solutions—from responsive, role-guarded web architectures to deep learning vision modules and cloud-synced mobile apps. I thrive on solving complex computational challenges and translating ideas into clean, maintainable code.

featuredProject.name: Doctor Appointment Booking System
featuredProject.summary: A full-stack healthcare appointment management platform featuring dedicated Patient, Doctor, and Admin portals with Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).
featuredProject.architecture: React.js • Node.js • Express.js • MongoDB • JWT Auth • Cloudinary • Tailwind CSS
points: Architected multi-portal workflows for Patients, Doctors, and Administrators with role-based authorization guards.
Built secure JWT authentication, session middleware, and RESTful APIs for appointment scheduling, cancellation, and doctor availability management.
Integrated MongoDB for structured data storage and Cloudinary for doctor credentials and profile media uploads.
Engineered responsive, accessible dashboards using React.js and Tailwind CSS with real-time schedule management.
features: Doctor Verification & Credential Upload via Cloudinary

otherProjects.name: Real-Time Age & Gender Detection System
otherProjects.summary: An optimized real-time computer vision system using Python and OpenCV DNN to detect faces and estimate age group and gender from video feeds.
otherProjects.architecture: Python • OpenCV DNN • Pre-trained TensorFlow Models • NumPy • Matplotlib
points: Developed a real-time face detection and demographic classification application using OpenCV Deep Neural Network (DNN) modules.
Implemented image preprocessing, face alignment, deep learning inference, and real-time bounding box annotations.
Optimized frame-by-frame processing to achieve smooth FPS during live webcam streams and support batch offline image analysis.
Engineered confidence threshold filtering to ensure accurate predictions across variable lighting conditions.

otherProjects.name: Smart Expense Tracker
otherProjects.summary: A native Android mobile application to record, categorize, and manage personal expenses with real-time cloud synchronization.
otherProjects.architecture: Java • Android SDK • XML UI • Firebase Realtime Database • Material Design
points: Built a native Android app with clean Material Design UI for daily income and expenditure tracking.
Integrated Firebase Realtime Database for zero-latency cloud sync, multi-device access, and offline persistence.
Implemented CRUD operations for transactions, automated balance calculation, and category-wise expense breakdowns.
Added transaction history filtering, search capabilities, and spending threshold alerts for financial tracking.

otherProjects.name: Campus Connect Platform
otherProjects.summary: A centralized digital portal for university clubs, event registration workflows, announcements, and student participation tracking.
otherProjects.architecture: React.js • Node.js • Express.js • MongoDB • RESTful APIs
points: Designed student and organizer flows for club announcements, registrations, and participation tracking.
Implemented administrative approval workflows for campus activities and automated registration counters.
Created a responsive announcement feed with fast search and category filtering.
Led an intra-club competitive programming event for 40+ engineering students, organizing problem sets and contest strategies.
Conducted a hands-on technical workshop on AWS Cloud Services, introducing core cloud fundamentals and real-world deployment patterns.
Mentored junior peers in frontend development fundamentals, React, and REST API integration.
